items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I think Plessy did that too for me.

ctx.x: He wrote Camel Walk, didn't he?

Yeah, yeah. He wrote Camel Walk. See, I hadn't even remembered that. Camel Walk, yeah. Well, of course, those numbers were published by the Triangle, you see. Now, you see, someday more movies were published by that. Triangle Blues, I think. I think Plessy did that too for me. Yeah. And Cookie. I don't know who published Cookie. Here it is right here.
Let's see. Oh, yeah. Universal Music Publishing.
